summary: Completed comprehensive testing of P2 features: Salary Structures with detailed allowances, Public Holidays management, and Auto Journal Entries for milk purchases/sales. All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing verified salary structures page, edit dialog with 10 allowance fields, holidays tab, and add holiday dialog.

salary_structures_page.details: Page loads at /salary-structures with 58 employees, 2 defined structures, total salaries 1,409.978 OMR, 3 public holidays. Two tabs: هيكل الرواتب and العطل الرسمية

salary_structures_api.details: GET /api/hr/salary-structures returns all structures. GET /api/hr/salary-structures/{employee_id} returns structure with all 9 allowance fields. POST creates/updates structure with correct total calculation.

edit_salary_dialog.details: Dialog opens with all 10 allowance fields: الراتب الأساسي, بدل السكن, بدل النقل, بدل الطعام, بدل الهاتف, بدل الوقود, بدل التعليم, بدل طبي, بدل خاص, بدلات أخرى. Shows summary with basic salary, total allowances, and total salary.

public_holidays_api.details: GET /api/hr/public-holidays returns holidays list. POST creates new holiday with name, date, days, is_paid. DELETE removes holiday. Filter by year works.

holidays_tab.details: Tab shows 3 public holidays (العيد الوطني - National Day) with columns: اسم العطلة, التاريخ, عدد الأيام, مدفوعة?, ملاحظات. Delete button available.

add_holiday_dialog.details: Dialog has fields: اسم العطلة (عربي), اسم العطلة (إنجليزي), التاريخ, عدد الأيام, مدفوعة الأجر?, ملاحظات

auto_journal_entries.details: Required accounts exist (5100, 2110, 1111, 1120, 4100). create_auto_journal_entry function creates balanced journal entries for milk_purchase and milk_sale reference types.

validation.details: API correctly rejects missing employee_id (400) and invalid employee_id (404)

updated_files: /app/tests/test_salary_structures_holidays.py - Created comprehensive tests for salary structures, public holidays, and auto journal entries

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 tests passed, 1 skipped due to no customers)

seed_data_creation: Created test salary structure for first employee (basic: 500, allowances: 265, total: 765). Test holidays cleaned up after tests.

All APIs working correctly. No mocked APIs.
